notes.title: 🛠️ Small Patch: Fixed multiplayer – Update 0.3.1
notes.notes:

We’re truly sorry—for the delay and for the bugged demo launch. We’ve shipped fixes and the [b]demo should be working fine now[/b]. Over the next few weeks, we’ll roll out steady updates to keep improving your experience. 🩹

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]🎯 What We’re Improving Next[/h3][list][*][p][b]Smoother animations[/b] — tighter movement, cleaner transitions, better first-person feel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better replication[/b] — more reliable multiplayer state, fewer desyncs, cleaner handoffs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New missions[/b] — fresh objectives to make each run tenser and more varied.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Environmental upgrades[/b] — lighting, atmosphere, and points of interest for deeper mood.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI enhancements [/b]— flashlight icon, better inventory + showing exactly what the objectives are and more.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🧠 Known Focus / Next Up[/h3][list][*][p][b]Enemy AI[/b] — actively working on smarter behavior and scarier encounters.

Until then, expect frequent demo updates as we keep polishing animations, replication, missions, and the environment. 💪 [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]💬 Tell Us What To Improve[/h3][p]Your feedback guides the next patches—missions, QoL, scares, anything.
[b]Join our Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.me/bjqpj3dzrb"]Click  here to suggest features & report issues[/url] 📣 [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]

notes.title: 📝 Major Update: Co-Op Clarity & Sharper Fear – Update 0.3
notes.notes:
[h3]🧭 Co-Op & Objectives[/h3]
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]🔑 Change[/p][/th][th][p]🌟 Why it matters[/p][/th][/tr]
[tr][td][p][b]Clients can collect notes[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Progress now counts no matter who finds documents—teams don’t bottleneck on the host.[/p][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][p][b]Compass points to teammates & objectives[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Easier splits and regrouping; see allies and goals at a glance to keep momentum up.[/p][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][p][b]Extra objective at spawn fixed[/b][/p][/td][td][p]No more phantom task appearing at match start.[/p][/td][/tr]
[/table]

[h3]😱 Fear & Presence Systems[/h3]
[list]
[*][p][b]Working scare effect[/b] – No longer triggers at the beginning of a match; timing and gating are corrected so scares land when they should.[/p]
[*][p][b]“Living Presence” tuning[/b] – Detection range reduced for cleaner signal; nearest-presence now matches on client & server correctly.[/p]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]🔦 Gear & Settings[/h3]
[list]
[*][p][b]Better flashlight[/b] – Clearer visibility and more reliable targeting in dark spaces.[/p]

[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]🛠️ Fixes & Stability[/h3]
[list]
[*][p]Resolved: extra objective spawning on start.[/p]
[*][p]Resolved: client not registered as a “living presence” when adjacent to another player.[/p]
[*][p]Resolved: presence indicator range was too generous—now tighter and more informative.[/p]
[*][p]Addressed: notes falling through floor on client during generation; monitoring for edge cases.[/p]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]🧭 Known Issue / Next Up[/h3]
[list]
[*][p][b]Enemy AI[/b] – Currently working on making the enemy AI better.[/p]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]📝 Patch Notes (0.3)[/h3]
[list]
[*][p]Clients can collect notes; collection no longer host-gated.[/p]
[*][p]Compass now tracks [b]players + objectives[/b] to support team splits.[/p]
[*][p]Scare effect timing fixed; no early-match triggers.[/p]
[*][p]“Living Presence” range reduced; client/server parity fixed.[/p]
[*][p]Better flashlight behavior and clarity.[/p]
[*][p]Added in-game [b]FOV slider[/b].[/p]
[*][p]Fixed extra objective spawning at start.[/p]
[*][p]Notes-through-floor issue addressed on client (continuing to monitor).[/p]

[p]Keep the reports coming—your clips and notes directly shape the next patches. [/p]

notes.title: 📝 Major Update: Multiplayer & Monster Overhaul – Update 0.2.2
notes.notes: [h2]🎮 Multiplayer Re-Enabled[/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]🔑 Change[/p][/th][th][p]🌟 Why it matters[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Steam Sockets NetDriver[/b] is now compiled in & on by default.[/p][/td][td][p]Gives secure NAT traversal and cross-platform relays while shaving ∼15 ms off median RTT in EU↔US tests.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]9999 ms ping bug fixed[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Server browser finally shows real latency instead of the placeholder value older drivers produced. [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Version lock[/b][/p][/td][td][p]0.2.2 clients only list 0.2.2 servers to prevent mismatched packets.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][hr][/hr][h2]🌓 Visual Clarity & Performance[/h2][list][*][p][b]Reflections dial-down[/b] – We lowered Screen-Space Reflection quality per Epic’s guide, recovering 5-10 FPS on mid-range GPUs while reducing the “hall-of-mirrors” look.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Brightness pass[/b] – Auto-exposure upper limit raised by +0.3 EV, leveraging the extended luminance range option for more readable nights without losing mood.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated Lumen presets[/b] – UE 5.6 ships with cheaper global-illum tweaks; we adopted those for parity lighting at the same frame cost.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🧠 Smarter, Meaner Monsters[/h2][p]Our enemies now run a [b]Utility AI[/b] brain evaluated every 0.25 s, then follow a pacing [b]Director[/b] that decides when to stalk, ambush, or panic teams.[/p][h3]Highlights[/h3][list][*][p][b]Aggro Meter[/b] – Fills at 0.25 pts/s and +5 pts per document, then decays if you escape.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic scaling[/b] – Volley damage and hunter pack size grow over time for rising tension.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Volley combat[/b] – New attack montages trigger damage spheres mid-swing for readable telegraphs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Evade & teleport[/b] – Hunters reposition when kited or spotted too early, maintaining pressure.[/p][/*][/list][p]Expect [b]two more AI iterations[/b]: we’re analysing gameplay clips to fine-tune stalk distance, flee triggers, and volley size.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔍 Enemy AI – Under the Hood[/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][th][p]Sub-system[/p][/th][th][p]Core Function[/p][/th][th][p]TL;DR[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Perception[/b][/p][/td][td][p]OnPerceptionUpdated[/p][/td][td][p]Sight + hearing with 2 % “miss” chance so monsters stay imperfect.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Utility scoring[/b][/p][/td][td][p]EvaluateUtility[/p][/td][td][p]Weighs nine actions (Idle → Evade) every 0.25 s.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Aggro loop[/b][/p][/td][td][p]UpdateAggro[/p][/td][td][p]Time-based gain, doc pickups, decay, and hint spikes.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Volley attack[/b][/p][/td][td][p]DoAttack / HandleAttacking[/p][/td][td][p]Plays random montage → fires synced damage sphere up to 5 hits.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Director hooks[/b][/p][/td][td][p]OnDirectorHint[/p][/td][td][p]Guides two closest active hunters toward the lowest-threat player to balance pacing. [/p][/td][/tr][/table][hr][/hr][h2]📅 Roadmap[/h2][list][*][p][b]Hint System UI[/b] – In active development; ties Director cues to on-screen prompts so late joiners orient quickly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Objective Overhaul[/b] – Layered tasks beyond “collect docs,” adding strategic choices per match.[/p][/*][*][p][b]AI Polish Pass[/b] – Audio barks, death animations, and final balance scheduled for the next two patches.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]📝 Patch Notes (0.2.2)[/h2][list][*][p]Migrated core project to [b]Unreal Engine 5.6[/b]. [/p][/*][*][p]Enabled [b]Steam Sockets[/b] networking by default. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed server browser ping mis-reporting.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Screen-Space Reflection quality & lowered reflection capture resolution. [/p][/*][*][p]Exposure +0.3 EV for night readability. [/p][/*][*][p]Added Utility-AI brain, adaptive aggro, and synced attack montages.[/p][/*][*][p]Memory still down ~40 % from prior texture trims and pooling. [/p][/*][*][p]Director now enforces “lull” windows to avoid constant panic spikes. [/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🙏 Thank You![/h3][p]Thanks to everyone for the support and feedback so far. If you run into any issues, please let us know! Your feedback drives every patch![/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Small Update: Memory & Build Optimization Update and more!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello everyone,[/b]

We've just rolled out a small but impactful update, focusing on enhancing your gameplay experience. Here's what's new:

[/p][h3]🧠 Reduced RAM Usage by 50%[/h3][p]We’ve slashed RAM usage by [i][b]~30–40%[/b][/i]! This major reduction should help players on lower-spec machines and reduce memory-related issues.[/p][h3]🛠 Crash Fixes & Stability[/h3][p]We’ve aggressively minimized crashing and memory leaks—crash frequency is now much lower. That said, we’re [i][b]still monitoring[/b][/i] and addressing any rare issues that pop up.[/p][h3]📦 Optimized Project Size[/h3][p]We've reduced overall project size significantly—down by over half. This will help with download times and storage overhead.[/p][h3]🎯 What’s Next?[/h3][list][*][p][b]Smarter AI[/b]: We’re actively working on AI improvements—making enemies more intelligent and reactive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hint System Progress[/b]: As promised, the hint system is still in development.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧩 Context & Tech Breakdown[/h3][p]We utilized profiling tools to identify the biggest memory hogs—textures, asset loading, and runtime allocations—and focused our efforts there [/p][p][/p][p]We trimmed oversized textures, cleaned up unused assets, and implemented object pooling where needed. Bonus: the in-engine Addressables-style loading now loads assets just-in-time—reducing peak memory even further [/p][p][/p][h3]🔍 Why This Matters[/h3][list][*][p]Less RAM = fewer crashes and better performance on mid-range systems[/p][/*][*][p]Smaller build = quicker downloads and less disk usage[/p][/*][*][p]Smart AI & hint systems = more polished, immersive experience[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks to everyone for the support and feedback so far. If you run into any issues, please let us know! We’ll continue reporting back as AI gets smarter and the hint system becomes fully integrated.[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Small Update: Graphics, Controls, Sound, Performance & More!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've just rolled out a small but impactful update, focusing on enhancing your gameplay experience. Here's what's new:

[b]🎨 Graphics Enhancements[/b]
We've fine-tuned the visuals to make the game more immersive and visually appealing. Expect crisper textures and improved lighting effects that bring the game world to life.

[b]🕹️ Control Adjustments[/b]
By popular demand, the default mouse controls are now set to standard orientation. No more inverted mouse by default—though you can still switch back in the settings if you prefer.

[b]🔊 Sound Improvements[/b]
Audio has been refined for a more immersive experience. You'll notice clearer sound effects and better audio balance throughout the game.

[b]🚀 Performance Boosts[/b]
Significant optimizations have been implemented to enhance performance. You should experience smoother gameplay and faster load times across various systems.

[b]💡 Upcoming Features: In-Game Hints[/b]
We're currently working on integrating a hint system to assist players during challenging moments. Stay tuned for more details in future updates!

[i]Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Your input is invaluable as we strive to improve the game.[/i]

[b]Happy gaming![/b]

notes.title: 🎮 Demo Launch Today – Early Access Coming August 27th!
notes.notes:
[b]📢 Event Description:[/b]
We're incredibly excited — and deeply thankful — to announce that the demo for Blood Moon Horror is now live!

This is your chance to experience the first slice of our intense, horror game set in the far reaches of space. Explore eerie environments, survive the unknown, and uncover chilling secrets that hint at the full story yet to come.

The demo gives you a first taste of the ambiance, gameplay mechanics, and fear-focused design that define Blood Moon Horror. It’s just the beginning — and we couldn’t have reached this point without you, our community.

[b]🗓 Mark your calendars:[/b]
On [b]August 27th[/b], Blood Moon Horror enters Early Access. Expect new areas, expanded content, refined systems, and many updates shaped by your feedback. Early Access is our way of building this world together — your voice matters.

Whether you're here for the scares, the story, or the survival — thank you for being a part of this journey. Your support, encouragement, and passion keep the horror alive.

➡ Download the demo now and wishlist the game to be ready for Early Access!

[b]From the entire team: Thank you for playing, supporting, and believing in Blood Moon Horror[/b].

notes.title: We've Hit 1,000 Wishlists! A Huge Thank You to Everyone!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're excited to share that Blood Moon Horror has just hit 1,000 wishlists! This is a huge milestone for us, and we're incredibly grateful for all the support. Whether you're here because you can't wait to play the game or you're interested in our development journey, we appreciate you.

We're hard at work on a demo that's coming out in the next couple of months. We're really looking forward to everyone getting a chance to experience what we've been creating.

Also, keep an eye on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCk0TiGpMDpxR1izZfxcIMCg]YouTube channel[/url] in the coming months. We'll be releasing sneak peeks and more to give you a taste of what's to come.

Your feedback and ideas are always welcome. Don't hesitate to share what excites you about the game or any suggestions you have. Engaging with the community is something we love.

If you haven't joined yet, consider following us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/BJQpJ3dzRb]Discord[/url] and social media channels for the latest updates.

Thanks again for being part of this journey! Your support means the world to us!
